frames.title: Lesson 26 · Controlling hypothetical structures — production and review

body: **Foco:** Controle de estruturas hipotéticas — produção e revisão.
**Phrasal verbs:** crack down on.
**Pronúncia:** Ritmo e ênfase para nuances.
**24 palavras novas** (linguagem especializada).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo produzir e revisar um editorial com estruturas hipotéticas controladas e usar crack down on.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: Enforcement Without Excuses
paras: Had the regulator **cracked down on** misleading adverts a decade ago, consumers **would not be** paying the price today. **Were** it to act now, trust **might** slowly recover. **Unless** penalties **are** real, firms **will** keep gambling. **Provided** the rules are clear, honest businesses **have nothing to fear**.

**Suppose** the watchdog **had been** given more staff: **would** it **have been** so passive? We doubt it. **But for** political reluctance, the problem **would have been** solved. **It is high time** officials **acted**.

items.q: The regulator acted a decade ago.
The editorial argues that real penalties matter.
It is not yet time to act.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Had** the regulator cracked down…; **Were** it to act…
**Unless** penalties are real…; **Provided** rules are clear…
**It is high time** officials **acted**; **But for** reluctance…

blocks.body: Revisão: confira (1) o **tempo da condição**, (2) o **tempo do resultado**, (3) a **inversão sem if**, (4) *it is high time + passado*.
*Unless* já contém negação: *Unless penalties are real* (não *unless… are not*).

items.s: ___ the regulator cracked down, consumers would not be paying now. (had)
___ penalties are real, firms will keep gambling. (unless)
It is high time officials ___ . (act, past)
But ___ political reluctance, it would have been solved. (for)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Crack the whip.** — Impor disciplina.
**Throw the book at.** — Aplicar a pena máxima.
**Turn a blind eye.** — Fazer vista grossa.
**Come down hard on.** — Ser duro com.
**Cut corners.** — Fazer de qualquer jeito.
**A wake-up call.** — Um alerta.
**Too little, too late.** — Pouco e tarde.
**Call to account.** — Cobrar responsabilidade.
**Clean up one’s act.** — Melhorar a conduta.
**Take firm action.** — Agir com firmeza.
**What is the main argument?** — Qual é o argumento principal?
**And the call to action?** — E o chamado à ação?
**It is high time officials cracked down.** — Já era hora de os dirigentes reprimirem.

head: Phrasal verb
Significado
Exemplo
rows: Police cracked down on fraud. — A polícia endureceu contra fraudes.

blocks.title: Newsroom
lines: Had the regulator acted earlier, consumers wouldn’t be paying now.
Se o regulador tivesse agido antes, os consumidores não pagariam agora.
It is high time officials cracked down.
Já era hora de os dirigentes reprimirem.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.model: Had we invested, we would be safer now.
Provided the rules are clear, honest firms have nothing to fear.
It is high time the council acted.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence editorial paragraph using inversion, a mixed conditional, unless/provided and it is high time.
blocks.model: Had the council inspected the building last year, residents would be safe today. Were it to act now, confidence might return. Unless inspections are frequent, owners will cut corners. Provided the rules are clear, responsible landlords have nothing to fear. But for years of neglect, the crisis would not have arisen. It is high time officials cracked down.

items.why: **consumer watchdog** = órgão de defesa do consumidor.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
